services.name: Wave Runners - Jet Skis
services.desc: All Powered Watercraft Rentals Require a $500 Security Deposit. All Power Craft Rentals Will Begin at the Cove Corner Store for Pre-Rental Paperwork and Proper Rental Instructions. With Rental Agreement Completion, the Watercraft will be delivered to the Crooked River Day Use Boat Ramp. All rentals plus Gasoline cost. A free boaters license is included in the rental cost. Rentals must be returned clean or a $25.00 cleaning fee will be assessed. Wave Runners are Inspected on Return where Renter is Responsible for Damage. No overnight rentals are allowed on Wave Runners. All Boat Reservations require a $50 Non-Refundable Deposit that will be applied towards your boat rental(s). Please note

blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats, ski boats, wave-runners, and more for a day on Lake Billy Chinook. Ski boats come with water skis and options for tubes or wakeboards. The resort store offers summer apparel, snacks, ice cream, souvenirs, fishing tackle, and camping equipment.
